slots.notes: Inter, loaded globally and declared as the app font; the single typeface for the whole section - the 'FAQ' pill, the 'Answers to the questions / that come up most.' heading, the right intro paragraph, the category pill buttons, the 'Got Questions?' card, and every accordion question/answer. Acts as both display and body since no second face is declared.

Material Symbols Outlined icon font (variable axes FILL/wght/GRAD/opsz) loaded globally via a Google Fonts <link>; supplies the single 'expand_more' glyph rendered at size 16 inside the 28px (h-7 w-7) circular accordion toggle button, which rotates 180 degrees on open. Tinted via currentColor (text-foreground/70), not a swappable image asset.

mechanic: A static two-column FAQ section (a left lg:sticky pill-button category switcher plus a 'Got Questions?' email card, beside a single-open Radix accordion of the active category's rows) where every SpotlightBorder wrapper and every accordion card carries an independent cursor-tracked 1px white radial-gradient ring (mask-composite), rows expand via Radix accordion-down/up height keyframes with a 180-degree chevron rotation, switching category re-keys the items to collapse them, and the pill, heading, paragraph, and each FAQ row fade up on scroll with a 0.15s-per-row stagger.
techDelivery: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + TailwindCSS (semantic foreground/background tokens plus landing.* extend colors) + framer-motion + Radix UI Accordion (@radix-ui/react-accordion), with a clsx/tailwind-merge cn() helper; authored as a multi-file drop-in component spec (FaqSection plus MIcon/FadeUp/SpotlightBorder and a shadcn-style Accordion wrapper), not a single-file CDN bundle. Inter and Material Symbols Outlined are loaded via Google Fonts in index.html.
reskinNotes:
The design is monochrome - no accent color is declared - and almost every color is a raw white opacity rather than a token: white/10 and white/15 borders, white/[0.04] fills, and text-foreground at /60 /70 /80 baked across the markup, so a palette swap must edit those utilities, not just the bg/foreground tokens. The spotlight ring is a hardcoded white rgba inside the radial-gradient string of SpotlightBorder / spotlightMaskStyle, so any tint or accent requires a code edit. All copy is hardcoded in the component: the 'FAQ' pill, the 'Answers to the questions / that come up most.' heading (split by a
that only shows on sm+), the right paragraph, the three category labels (General / AI & Capabilities / Integrations & Security) and their CategoryKey union type, the fifteen question/answer pairs in the faqs record, the 'Got Questions?' card heading and body, and the mailto:hello@uirocket.com 'Email us' CTA (the email address is also baked into the href). The chevron is the Material Symbols glyph name 'expand_more' rather than a swappable asset, and the per-card spotlight relies on a useEffect mousemove listener writing CSS vars onto element bounding rects.
